title: Normalized map price definition (legacy map_prices domain)
description: Contract for one normalized map price: one stored legacy map_prices entry in positional schedule order. The schedule carries no stable stored id (the legacy loader indexes positionally), so legacy_id is the 0-based positional index as a string (rule E2); all native amounts are kept verbatim (rule E1). Stored values are identical to town_prices but preserved as a separate schedule, never deduplicated. See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Positional index of the stored map_prices entry as a decimal string (rule E2): the schedule has no stable stored id and the legacy loader indexes the array positionally.

kind.description: Classification of the stored map_prices domain: every entry maps to map_price.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets map_prices).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets map_prices).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

position.description: 0-based position of the entry in the stored map_prices array; the unlock schedule order is positional and preserved (rule E2).

coins.description: Native stored coin cost, kept verbatim (rule E1).

cash.description: Native stored cash cost, kept verbatim (rule E1).

level.description: Native stored unlock level, kept verbatim (rule E1).
